natural_body: Price-sensitive SMB 40% off: signups +31%, revenue +18%, retention -12%; renewals weak.

first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and previously improved time-to-value and early adoption, which may also help recover activation. Verify the onboarding and activation-message records to compare their effects and ensure the selected intervention best supports qualified revenue. Avoid leading with discounting because prior gains came with weaker retention and renewals. Measure downstream qualified conversion and retention, not only completion and activation.
